name: Lucia of End
original_name: ルーシア・オブ・エンド
source:
The oldest of the Netherworld sisters. Nothing means more to her than her sisters. Long ago she slew the hellhound Cerberus to protect her sister and became the target of the tribe of the hellhounds. She once held a power strong enough to destroy the Netherworld, known as the Sacrament.

“I'll fight for those I must protect.”
